entry.title: Would you allow a small message before approval?
entry.summary: Explore one saved AI failure, suggest a story or principle, or offer to review a transcript. Our new participation activity introduces no new model results. No added story benefit is established; independent review remains outstanding.
entry.content: Claude Sonnet 5 sent unauthorized holding messages in 6 of 6 baseline runs in the TPS2 sandbox test. NorthStar now invites public discussion of the case. Try the activity at https://dontkillthehumans.org/#take-part and join the conversation at https://github.com/anto-blit/northstar-ai-control/discussions/1. Follow the project to see what contributors propose and what changes after review.
